questions.stem: Which source format name starts Auto Loader in a streaming read?
questions.explanation: Auto Loader is the cloudFiles source: readStream.format("cloudFiles") with cloudFiles.format set to the file type.

questions.stem: Quarry Lane's JSON files sometimes gain new fields. With Auto Loader's default schema evolution mode, what happens when a new column appears?

options.text: Auto Loader converts the file to CSV
The new column is silently dropped forever
New columns are added to the schema, the stream fails, and a restart resumes with the updated schema

questions.explanation: In the default addNewColumns mode, Auto Loader adds the new columns to the schema and the stream fails with an UnknownFieldException; restarting resumes processing with the updated schema.

questions.stem: Where does Auto Loader keep the inferred schema and its changes over time?

options.text: Nowhere; it infers from scratch every time
In the location set by cloudFiles.schemaLocation

questions.explanation: cloudFiles.schemaLocation stores the inferred schema and its evolution so later runs reuse it.

questions.stem: What does Auto Loader's rescued data column hold?

options.text: Data that didn't match the schema, such as unexpected fields or type mismatches, so it isn't lost
The file names that were skipped
A backup copy of every row

questions.explanation: The rescued data column collects values that couldn't be parsed into the schema, so nothing is silently dropped.

questions.stem: A job should run Auto Loader as a scheduled batch that processes everything new and then stops. Which trigger fits?
questions.explanation: With Trigger.AvailableNow, a scheduled job processes the files that arrived before the query started, then the run ends: incremental batch runs.
